queer_characters.name: Freddie Mercury
queer_characters.notes: Comes out as bisexual to Mary Austin; his bisexuality is shown via engagement to Mary and relationships with Paul Prenter and Jim Hutton. Critics (Vox, Empire, Variety) noted the film disengages from the 'gay' part and treats his queerness with 'kid-gloves reticence,' giving little space to happy gay relationships.

queer_characters.name: Jim Hutton
queer_characters.notes: Mercury becomes attracted to and enters a relationship with him; source text does not specify a more precise label for Hutton, and the romance is treated as restrained per critics.

queer_characters.name: Paul Prenter
queer_characters.notes: Described as being in a romantic relationship with Mercury; no specific label given in source. Source text does not detail characterization beyond the relationship.
